name: Cthulhu no Choushi ~Musei Doukoku~
original_name: クトゥルフの弔詞 ～夢声慟哭～
source:
A floppy disk arrived at the door of detective Horiguchi, who earns his daily bread by investigating affairs and searching for pets.

There was no sender's name on the envelope, only a notepaper that said, "I want you to find the person who wrote the nine notes on the disk," along with a cash deposit at a sum that hardly seemed like a prank.

Although he thought it was a strange request, he was hungry for work, so he reluctantly started investigating...

A businessman whose spirit has been taken over by a monster. An observer swallowed by the darkness of Antarctica. An amnesiac man discovered after an encounter with a strange insect...

In a storage medium that could no longer be called outdated, the world's most bizarre events were recorded.

How can one find the person who wrote such a delusional account?
It seems that this is going to be a more difficult request than anticipated...

[Translated from [url=https://freegame-mugen.jp/adventure/game_1470.html]Freegame Mugen[/url]]
translation:
靠调查婚外情、寻找宠物维持生计的侦探堀口，收到了一张送上门来的软盘。

信封上没有寄件人的姓名，里面只有一张写着“请找出软盘中九篇笔记的作者”的信纸，以及一笔数额大到不像恶作剧的订金。

虽然觉得这份委托很古怪，但他正愁没有工作，于是勉为其难地开始调查……

精神被怪物占据的商人，被南极黑暗吞噬的观测员，以及遭遇怪异昆虫后被人发现的失忆男子……

这张早已不止是“过时”二字所能形容的存储介质里，记录着世上最离奇的事件。

究竟要如何找到写下这些妄想般记述的人？
看来，这份委托比预想中还要棘手……

[译自[url=https://freegame-mugen.jp/adventure/game_1470.html]Freegame Mugen[/url]]
